Close controller check ✕

Xbox: hold Menu (☰) to open Edge’s context menu, move the pointer to “Use game controls”, then press A. The blue controller icon should have no red X. Browsing mode uses the stick as a mouse; its arrow events cannot identify individual controllers.

Press A on each controller after switching. Each needs its own slot below. If only one slot appears or both controllers affect the same slot, this page cannot separate them. Actual Xbox multi-controller operation is not yet verified.

Keyboard: WASD or arrow keys to move · Space to hop · X to baa · B to chomp · H for a hat. Click the meadow to focus. Touch controls appear below on touchscreens. Music and effects default on, with separate on/off buttons. Browsers may require one click on Start playing or Start audio before playback; a polled gamepad press alone may not unlock audio. Visual baa bubbles always work. Audio pauses when the page is hidden.

Checking browser controller support…

Disconnected sheep wait where they are. Reconnect in the same controller slot to continue. Refresh the page to start a new flock. The stick controls full 360° movement and smooth facing; tilt lightly to move slowly. B chomps nearby sheep in a forward cone (3 health, 0.8-second cooldown). At zero, cartoon KO lasts 5 seconds, then the sheep returns with full health. No accounts, chat, purchases, or data collection inside the game.
